item.title: US reaches 1st Olympic curling mixed doubles final, facing Sweden for gold
item.description: Korey Dropkin and Cory Thiesse guaranteed the U.S. its first Olympic medal in mixed doubles curling, reaching the final Monday with a 9-8 victory over Italy.

item.title: Waukee's rapid growth brings major developments and amenities
item.description: WAUKEE, Iowa -- Waukee was recently recognized as the fastest-growing Des Moines suburb with several major retail and residential developments. item.title: After welcome reprieve, construction expected to restart on Ingersoll this spring
item.description: DES MOINES, Iowa -- Construction is expected to start up again on Ingersoll Avenue this spring. item.title: 2 barns destroyed in Lawton-area grass fire
item.description: Multiple Siouxland Fire Departments responded to a grass fire that quickly turned into a structure fire that destroyed two barns.
